C-15.Name: Platform distribution hardening incl. Apple App Store
C-15.Summary: User idea (session 2026-09-18): "настроить дистрибуцию под платформы включая апстор". Extend distribution beyond the current channels (in-app updater, GitHub Releases DMG, Homebrew cask): Apple App Store submission (needs Apple Developer Program membership, proper signing identity + provisioning, hardened runtime review compliance, sandbox entitlements audit — Tauri WKWebView + fs access patterns will need a sandbox-compatibility pass), and optionally Windows/Linux artifacts if demand appears. NOT IMPLEMENTED — planning artifact.

Problem.Description: Distribution is GitHub-centric; App Store unreachable without signing/sandbox work.
Problem.RootCause: The port ships ad-hoc-signed DMGs; App Store requires a paid team identity, hardened runtime, and sandbox-compatible entitlements.
Problem.Evidence: User session 2026-09-18; current release.yml signs ad-hoc locally and CI-attests artifacts.

Goals.R-1: Inventory the sandbox gaps (fs watcher paths, arbitrary file open, Deep Links/CLI) against App Store sandbox requirements.
Goals.R-2: CI signing path with a real Developer ID for notarization (outside the store) as the prerequisite step.
Goals.R-3: App Store variant: separate bundle id, entitlements set, screenshot/metadata pipeline, TestFlight-first rollout.

Constraints.Constraint: App Store work starts only after Developer Program membership exists; no ad-hoc identities in CI secrets.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Windows/Linux builds in this change (separate consideration).

Amendments.Amendment: User: "двигаемся по винде и апстору, дай план" — Windows moves INTO scope (was a NonGoal). Correction to the 2026-09-18 evidence: CI release.yml ALREADY signs with a real Developer ID and notarizes (APPLE_* secrets, codesign+spctl gate), so R-2 is satisfied; the Apple Developer Program membership exists. Remaining for MAS: Distribution certificate, provisioning, sandbox entitlements work, App Store Connect record.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Notarized Developer ID build in CI is the prerequisite gate; App Store variant passes Transporter validation.

C-15.VerificationIntent: Notarization gate in CI; App Store validation via Transporter; TestFlight smoke.

Approval.ApprovedBy: user (session 2026-09-21): "двигаемся по винде и апстору" — execution approved incl. Windows track.
Approval.ApprovalScope: Implement both tracks: Windows (icons, titlebar/menu, cfg audit, CI build lane) and MAS (feature wiring, entitlements, sandbox pass, bookmarks, in-process search, UI gating, ASC submission prep).
